selected_entries.deferred_resolution: the bridge must submit the three model fields as null because it does not receive effective_char_info.hair_style.bangs_side; render_mii resolves, validates, and reports the exact model variant after normalization

validation_order: hash-validate this manifest and the bound runtime-normalization profile
normalize raw CharInfo and use only effective_char_info thereafter
resolve selector_index[logical_name][effective selector] and require the embedded entry_index
require the bridge entry_index/selector/resource_name exactly and require model_role/model_name/model_index to remain null/deferred
validate the exact Parts record/resource and its gate
hash-validate the selected Head named-UV sidecar and prepared BFRES attachment source, then require the exact set_hair/set_beard/set_nose/set_ear bind-world matrices
inside render_mii, resolve the exact variant (Hair through _hair_model_selection; other drawn entries through exact ModelUnit)
validate every shape binding/program/stage/CPU/texture/order contract from that resolved variant and report its model_role/model_name/model_index

global_rules.resource_key: logical_name + selector; active records bind one exact resource_name

normalization.order: after CharInfoEx validation and before every face/model/resource selection
normalization.rule: all selector and face/style predicates in this contract are evaluated after the checked runtime normalization

global_rules.nothing: is_nothing=true is an admitted exact no-draw and never loads a model
global_rules.stage: vertex and fragment instruction files must match the program ledger byte length and SHA-256
global_rules.binding: VertexSkinCount=0 uses the complete BFRES shape-bone chain; positive counts use MatrixToBoneList plus inverse binds
global_rules.head_attachment: Hair/HairFront use selected Head set_hair; Beard uses set_beard; Nose and Glass share set_nose; Ear uses the complete set_ear matrix before its CharInfo world-Y delta and opposite-side world-X reflection
global_rules.hair_role: _hair_model_selection resolves ordinary, explicit flipped, reflected-primary, and source-context-authorized hat roles
global_rules.ordering: BFRES shape order is preserved; Glass hides the inactive lens and Ear emits right then reflected-left
fail_closed: an exact GameAll program without a named current CPU equation
a Hat model role requested without the external for_hat=true call context
a nonzero or unknown hair_style_flags field
runtime normalization is absent/unverified, or the selected entry selector differs from effective CharInfo
any model, shape, material, binding, stage, texture assignment, or draw order outside its exact entry
